data.body: **[P2] Track whether the individual span has ended.** An unawaited child can start and complete its next step while `onInvocationEnd` awaits `forceFlush()`. `onOperationStart` still creates a recording span during that interval, but this invocation-wide flag routes its completion into the continuation branch. The original span never ends and is discarded by `resetInvocationState`, leaving its attempt spans and continuation links referencing an unexported span. Distinguish spans closed during the initial unwind from recording spans created afterward, and finalize the latter normally. Add a regression that starts and completes a step during a blocked flush.
